source.title: Disinhibition of aggression through diffusion of responsibility and dehumanization of victims

confidence_rationale: Uniquely high mapping fidelity: this is the one study located that puts a PURELY LINGUISTIC manipulation and a STRUCTURAL responsibility manipulation into the same factorial design, which is exactly the comparison MECH-012's 'primary medium' clause requires, and the linguistic factor won. Confidence is capped at 0.68 by source quality rather than by mapping: 1975, pre-registration era, a shock-escalation paradigm of a kind no longer run, effect sizes I could not verify from an accessible full text, and no direct replication identified. The finding is canonical and widely cited but I am relying on the literature's summary of the design rather than on the primary text.
failure_signatures: Dehumanizing characterisation was a MORE POTENT disinhibitor than diffused responsibility. Any REE account that models institutional harm primarily through responsibility STRUCTURE (who is accountable to whom) and treats the symbolic layer as commentary has the ordering backwards on the one direct test available.

The label was applied to the TARGET, not to the actor and not to the act. A mitigation that protects the agent's own residue channel -- reminding them that they acted, that it was their choice -- leaves this route entirely open, because the operation performed is on the admissibility of the victim to the harm calculus.

The humanized characterisation reduced punitiveness BELOW the neutral condition. The channel is bidirectional, so an REE symbol layer capable of producing institutional denial is necessarily also capable of producing institutional absorption; a design that permits only the suppressive direction is not modelling the same mechanism.

Punitiveness ESCALATED over trials in the disinhibited conditions rather than remaining at a fixed offset. A single symbolic act sets a trajectory, not a level, so a monitor that samples residue once after the framing will miss the compounding.

mapping.source_claim_statement: College students were given opportunities to punish another group with electric shock under either diffused (collective) or personalized responsibility, while the target group was characterised in humanized ('perceptive, understanding'), neutral, or dehumanized ('animalistic, rotten') terms in a remark the participants overheard. No authority pressure and no anonymity were induced -- only the actors' perception of their victims was manipulated. Both dehumanization and reduced personal responsibility increased the intensity of shock delivered, with dehumanization the more potent disinhibitor; humanized characterisation produced the greatest restraint.
mapping.ree_translation: This is the strongest direct support located for MECH-012's central and most contestable assertion -- that in collective systems LANGUAGE is the primary medium through which residue is managed or displaced. The claim's force depends on a comparison almost nobody runs: pit a symbolic operation against a structural one in the same design and see which dominates. Here a two-word characterisation overheard in passing dominated the responsibility structure. In REE terms, the symbolic act does not argue the agent out of their residue; it reclassifies the target's standing to generate residue at all, which is a cheaper and more durable operation than contesting any particular harm. The bidirectionality matters just as much: the humanized label produced restraint below baseline, so the same channel that lets an institution deny residue is the channel by which it can absorb it on a member's behalf. MECH-012 names both, and this is the one result showing both in a single design.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Fifty years old, from a research culture without preregistration, with sample sizes and analytic conventions of its era; I could not obtain full text and am relying on the secondary literature's account of the design, and I identified no direct replication. The 'collective' is an ad-hoc laboratory group of students with no persistence, roles or norms, so calling it an institution is REE's extension and not the authors'. The dependent measure is delivered shock intensity -- harm DELIVERY -- whereas MECH-012 is about residue MANAGEMENT; willingness to inflict more harm is consistent with attenuated residue but is not a measurement of it, and no affective or physiological index was recorded here. Finally, the shock paradigm carries its own demand characteristics, which the authors' no-authority-pressure design mitigates but does not remove.
mapping.source_context: Healthy adult humans (college students); laboratory aggression paradigm with ostensible shock delivery to a peer group; 2x3 manipulation of responsibility structure (diffused vs personalized) and linguistic characterisation of the target (humanized / neutral / dehumanized).

confidence_components.notes: The aggregate is deliberately pulled upward from the source_quality figure because MECH-012 is a mechanism_hypothesis: what governance needs to know is whether the proposed mechanism exists and how it ranks against its rival, and this is the only located design that answers the ranking question at all. source_quality is low for age, unverified statistics and absent replication, and that is what keeps the aggregate below 0.7 despite the fidelity.
